title: Routine vs opportunistic insider flow: CMP-style process classification on acceptance-PIT Form-4 (opportunistic net-direction anchor, large-size-bucket neighbour), per-sector net-zero on the death-inclusive cohort
arms_note: exactly three ARMS per the binding rule: anchor + neighbour + control arm. The control arm carries the TWO P3-mandated control books (sham-insider placebo + filing-arrival exposure-form) under the single control class, per p3_v13_invariants_freeze.json lane1_insider_control_mandate; both books run under identical decision dates, eligibility, book machinery and cost model, and both kill rules bind. A control that cannot run is a DESIGN FAILURE, not a pass.

mechanism.who_is_forced_or_underreacts: The constrained actor is again the corporate insider, but this family splits their flow by PROCESS rather than pooling it: routine trades are the calendar-repeating ones (10b5-1 plans, compensation-driven disposals, tax-driven sales) that an insider executes on a schedule largely independent of information state; opportunistic trades are the deviations from that own calendar. The underreacting actor is the marginal outside holder, who aggregates insider filings into a single 'insiders are buying/selling' impression and never conditions on whether the trade is scheduled: routine and opportunistic flow are priced alike when they are not alike in content (Cohen-Malloy-Pomorski 2012).
mechanism.why_the_effect_exists: An insider trading OUTSIDE their own repetition calendar is revealing state-dependent information: they are trading now, in size, because something changed. A calendar trade reveals nothing about state - CMP 2012 measure near-zero abnormal returns behind routine trades and economically large returns behind opportunistic ones. The classification is computable from acceptance timestamps alone (the same identity accepting an open-market row in the same month-of-year in >= 2 of the prior 3 years defines routine), so the process split is PIT-clean on this cycle's census without any self-reported field.
mechanism.observable: netdir_opp(e,t) = (I_buy_opp - I_sell_opp)/(I_buy_opp + I_sell_opp): the identity-deduplicated net-direction share of open-market non-derivative Form-4 rows (the frozen A/D code G primary observable) CLASSIFIED OPPORTUNISTIC by the frozen month-history rule, accepted in (prev(D), D], PIT = acceptance; long the most net-opportunistic-buy / short the most net-opportunistic-sell terciles, per-sector net-zero, on the 30 frozen quarterly decision dates. Neighbour: the same direction form restricted to the frozen >= 10k-share buckets.
mechanism.when_it_must_fail: (i) the opportunistic drift is efficiently priced after band costs; (ii) the sham-insider placebo reproduces the anchor same-sign >= 0.5x - the process label is decoration over window mass; (iii) the filing-arrival control reproduces the anchor - the split adds nothing over plain filing counts; (iv) the neighbour (large-bucket direction) carries the OPPOSITE sign - the process reading is not coherent with the size reading and is withdrawn; (v) SPY-excess/sector gates fail (sector-beta drowning); (vi) the opportunistic subset fails the per-fold funding floor at P2 (fold-1 under-seeding is the declared risk) - BLOCKED_DATA, the cheap death.
mechanism.which_control_kills_the_convenient_expla: The convenient explanation 'any signed aggregation of the window's rows works' is killed by the sham-insider placebo (direction permuted within date-sector cells; the frozen classification is direction-free and survives the permutation unchanged, so the sham preserves the exact routine/opportunistic composition while destroying the identity-direction linkage). The convenient explanation 'it is just filings/coverage at these names' is killed by the filing-arrival control (plain acceptance counts, no direction, no identity, no size, no process): if arrival carries the same spread, the process split is costume, and the family dies.

lineage_citations: Cohen, L., C. Malloy and L. Pomorski (2012), 'Decoding Inside Information', Journal of Finance 67(3) - the routine-vs-opportunistic split; routine trades carry no abnormal return, opportunistic trades carry economically large returns. The month-history classification here is CMP-faithful with one frozen adaptation: month-of-year matching uses the ACCEPTANCE month (single evidenced timestamp per row; post-2016 Section 16 deadline of 2 business days makes acceptance month approximate the trade month).
Seyhun, H.N. (1998), Investment Intelligence from Insider Trading (MIT Press) - the constrained-informed-trader foundation for why direction of open-market flow is informative at all.

Lakonishok, J. and I. Lee (2001), 'Are Insider Trades Informative?', Review of Financial Studies 14(1) - cross-sectional portfolio-form precedent; trades by officers/directors and larger trades are the informative strata (the large-bucket neighbour's lineage).

house standards: PIT = SEC filing acceptance timestamps (P-1); death-inclusive cohort with exit-at-last-close (V9 carry); falsification-by-control cluster (V5/V6 sham standard; V11/V12 measured precedents).

universe.cohort_slice: identical slice to sibling SFV13-A4-P1: cohort_v9.json sha256 6a95401ff84bff2144ac3c0b9426a6fa86daf3dde8d478195666249e3fa2aa62 bookable members, ALIVE_EVIDENCED 410 + DEAD_EVIDENCED 1769 = 2179 filer-entities; entity = issuerCik, a cohort member; universe identical, EXPOSURE different (the process-classified subset of the same stream).
universe.excluded_with_reasons: GAP_COVERAGE 513 (no price leg) and NOT_DEAD_NAME_ALIVE 19 (guard duplicates) excluded-with-reasons per the P0 census contract and the P3-frozen death_inclusive_universe.
universe.per_decision_eligibility: per decision date D: >= 1 in-window open-market direction-coded row (census bookable_pair definition) AND >= 63 price bars through D AND ADV63 >= 2,000,000 USD (band C or better; UNTRADABLE excluded, L-I3 fail-closed) AND raw close >= 1.00 USD AND the ARM's exposure is defined (anchor: >= 2 opportunistic rows; neighbour: >= 2 large-bucket rows - see features_and_lags) AND the frozen sector tag has >= 6 eligible ranked names, else that sector abstains for D.
universe.dead_alive_split: dead legs priced death-inclusive, exit-at-last-close; alive legs carry through the grid; the dead/alive split persisted per leg (P3 per_entity_legs).
universe.survivorship_honesty: dead side canary-verified this cycle (CANARY_PASS_CHANNEL_RETAINS_DEAD); 1562 dead entities with bookable pairs / 17072 pairs are the measured backbone. A survivor-only pool would censor exactly the net-opportunistic-sell mass - the death-inclusive cohort is the only honest universe for this reading.

clock.acceptance_window: acceptance datetime in (prev(D), D]; first date lower bound 2018-01-01 (grid start open), per the frozen census contract.
clock.gate_rule: gate(t) = 00:00 UTC of the decision session; only acceptances <= gate(t) enter any exposure or any classification input; fills STRICT_NEXT_BAR.
clock.book_folds: carried houses folds: S0_FOLD_1 2018-04-04..2020-09-01 (dates[0:10]), S0_FOLD_2 2020-09-10..2023-02-09 (dates[10:20]), S0_FOLD_3 2023-02-17..2025-07-24 (dates[20:30]); force-flat at every fold boundary.
clock.warmup_rationale: no decision dates are burned. The warmup here is DATA-side and declared: the CMP month-history classification needs identity history, seeded from the 2018-01-01 grid start. Identities with < 24 months of observed history before prev(D) cannot EVIDENCE routine repetition and default to OPPORTUNISTIC (repetition requires evidence). Declared fold-1 consequence: early fold-1 windows classify few identities routine, so the opportunistic-vs-all contrast is weakest in fold 1 and strengthens through folds 2-3; the neighbour needs no history seeding and provides fold-1 support. The classification rule and the 24-month seeding threshold are frozen here, before any PnL.

features_and_lags.source_fields: identical field set to sibling SFV13-A4-P1: documentType == '4'; issuerCik; rptOwnerCik / rptOwnerName; rptOwnerRelationship parsed and persisted, unused in exposures; transactionShares (frozen size class); transactionAcquiredDisposedCode (A/D); transactionCode recorded; acceptanceDateTime (PIT).
features_and_lags.stream_rule: nonDerivativeTable ONLY; the census contract's frozen open-market primary observable (the non-derivative A/D code G class) verbatim; direction '.' or missing and malformed XML rows FAIL-CLOSED to the defect table; nothing guessed.
features_and_lags.identity_rule: reporting owner = rptOwnerCik if present else normalized rptOwnerName + issuer CIK; dedup per (entity, window, identity, direction) within the arm's qualifying subset.
features_and_lags.classification_rule_frozen: CMP-style, computed ONLY from acceptance timestamps: a stream row of identity i on issuer e accepted in (prev(D), D] is ROUTINE iff identity i has >= 1 accepted stream row on the same issuer with the same ACCEPTANCE month-of-year in at least 2 of the 3 prior calendar years, where candidate prior rows are those with acceptance < prev(D) (knowable before the window opens - P-1); otherwise OPPORTUNISTIC. Month-of-year matching uses the acceptance month, never the self-reported transactionDate (asserted timestamps are never authorized; transactionDate is persisted but enters no timing input).
features_and_lags.anchor_exposure: netdir_opp(e,t) = (I_buy_opp - I_sell_opp) / (I_buy_opp + I_sell_opp) over stream rows classified OPPORTUNISTIC; count-based, identity-deduplicated, no price input. DEFINED iff >= 2 in-window opportunistic stream rows.
features_and_lags.neighbour_exposure: netdir_large(e,t) = (I_buy_large - I_sell_large) / (I_buy_large + I_sell_large) over stream rows in the frozen >= 10k-share buckets (10k-100k + >= 100k), NO process filter; DEFINED iff >= 2 in-window large-bucket stream rows.
features_and_lags.lookback_window: exposure: exactly one acceptance window (prev(D), D]. Classification: identity history only, with all candidate rows accepted < prev(D). No price input anywhere in either.
features_and_lags.pit_rule: PIT = SEC filing acceptance timestamps ONLY (P-1 absolute; 100% populated in the measured census); the conditioner never reads a price series.
features_and_lags.lag_mutation: P3 availability-lag mutation at test level: pushing an acceptance stamp later moves that row across at most one decision-date boundary (window membership and/or classification candidacy), moving the affected entity's exposure by at most one period; larger propagation = implementation leak, arm NOT_RUN fail-closed.
features_and_lags.truncation_honesty: the 9 TRUNCATION_SLICE entities' lower-bound counts used as measured, flags persisted - never silently backfilled.

size_class_usage.frozen_buckets: <1k / 1k-10k / 10k-100k / >=100k shares on transactionShares, frozen in the P0 parse contract.
size_class_usage.usage: THIS proposal's axis is the size dimension's informative stratum: the NEIGHBOUR conditions on the two large buckets (10k-100k, >= 100k) pooled; the ANCHOR is bucket-agnostic within the opportunistic subset (process, not size). The two small buckets are excluded from the neighbour only - never from the anchor.
size_class_usage.diagnostics: per-bucket row counts, per-bucket signed shares, and the routine/opportunistic composition PER BUCKET are persisted so the interaction of the two dimensions is visible, never absorbed. Bucket thresholds are frozen - zero researcher degrees of freedom.

entry_exit_fills.window_convention: STRICT_NEXT_BAR declared ex-ante (no SAME_DAY_INCLUSIVE anywhere): exposures at decision date D from acceptances in (prev(D), D] under gate(t) = 00:00 UTC; fills at the NEXT allowed session close; missing bar at the fill session = the order does not exist.
entry_exit_fills.rebalance: one grid step, wholesale recomputation each decision date (a quarterly event-window exposure is stale one quarter later); no rank hysteresis.
entry_exit_fills.fold_force_flat: all legs closed at every fold boundary (2020-09-01, 2023-02-09, 2025-07-24); no position carries across folds.
entry_exit_fills.book_form: daily-marked, quarterly-rebalanced per-sector net-zero long/short on the frozen SIC-to-SPDR map (unchanged): >= 6 eligible ranked names per sector, long the TOP tercile of the arm's exposure, short the BOTTOM tercile, equal-weight within legs, per-sector net zero; CASH absorbs residual; >= 1 non-CASH leg per decision; gross <= 2.0; reconcile to 1.0 within 1e-9; boundary ties join the lower (short-side) tercile.
entry_exit_fills.costs: band A/B/C 10/15/25 bps per side, charged exactly once per fill, linear in fills, on BOOKED PnL (kernel_band_cost_v9.py verbatim); L-I3 fail-closed (BandResolutionError, never the silent 10 bps fallback); exits via resolve_exit_band_bps (C-rate 25 bps ceiling when UNTRADABLE/missing).
entry_exit_fills.stress: stress rerun cost_mult 2.0 (20/30/50 bps per side) on booked PnL; stress-tier survival is a primary stage-A gate.
entry_exit_fills.benchmark: risk-matched SPY-excess alpha and sector-EW relative performance per arm per fold; ETF positive-share gate <= 0.50 (expected 0.00).
entry_exit_fills.provision_2_1_status: the V11 sec2.1 sector-residual (ETF-leg) provision is deliberately NOT invoked - per-sector net-zero on cohort equities neutralizes sector exposure and preserves dead-leg exit honesty; justification frozen before selection; gates apply unchanged either way.

anchor_arm.spec: exposure netdir_opp(e,t) per features_and_lags; per-sector net-zero tercile book (long top / short bottom).
anchor_arm.claim: opportunistic (off-own-calendar) open-market insider net-direction concentration predicts SAME-SIGN next-quarter drift on the death-inclusive cohort after band costs and beyond SPY/sector beta, while routine flow - the majority mass of insider trading - carries no such content (CMP 2012): the identifying content is the DEVIATION from an identity's own repetition calendar, computable from acceptance timestamps alone.

neighbour_arm.exposure: netdir_large(e,t): the same direction form on the frozen >= 10k-share buckets, no process filter.
neighbour_arm.distinctness: process dimension (anchor) vs size dimension (neighbour): they diverge materially - a single large routine 10b5-1 sale ranks an entity high-magnitude on netdir_large while netdir_opp is untouched; small opportunistic buys do the reverse. Not a parameter wiggle.
neighbour_arm.required_support: same sign as the anchor. If netdir_large carries the OPPOSITE sign, the process reading is withdrawn - declared support-failure, not a tuning opportunity.

sham_insider_placebo.mandate_citation: p3_v13_invariants_freeze.json v13_additions.lane1_insider_control_mandate.sham_insider_placebo: matched windows on PERMUTED identity/direction - MUST NOT reproduce the anchor; a sham that cannot run is a DESIGN FAILURE.
sham_insider_placebo.construction: for each decision date t and sector tag, permute the direction code (A/D) uniformly across ALL in-window stream rows of that sector's eligible entities (CIK-sorted, acceptance-ordered within CIK) - numpy PCG64 seed 20260909, per cell, in decision-date session order, deterministic and frozen - then recompute the FULL anchor machinery INCLUDING the frozen classification: the classification is direction-free (it keys on identity, issuer and acceptance month-of-year history), so it survives the permutation UNCHANGED and the sham preserves the exact routine/opportunistic composition while destroying the identity-direction linkage. Identity dedup, floors, terciles, costs, folds all recompute.
sham_insider_placebo.matched_windows: identical acceptance windows, decision dates, eligibility, machinery and costs - nothing but the direction-identity linkage differs.
sham_insider_placebo.runnability: permutes measured values, asserts nothing; recomputes under any semantics change (P-3); cannot be NOT_RUN by design.
sham_insider_placebo.kill_rule: sham |alpha| >= 0.5x anchor |alpha| SAME SIGN on the identifying metric (anchor overall risk-matched SPY-excess alpha) => family DEAD (falsification-by-control).

filing_arrival_exposure_form.mandate_citation: p3_v13_invariants_freeze.json v13_additions.lane1_insider_control_mandate.exposure_form_control: plain filing-arrival books at the same dates without identity/direction must NOT reproduce the anchor.
filing_arrival_exposure_form.construction: exposure_arr(e,t) = log1p(n4(e,t)), n4 = count of the entity's Form-4 acceptances of ANY kind in (prev(D), D] (no direction, no identity, no size class, no process classification, no open-market filter); defined iff n4 >= 1; identical per-sector tercile book machinery, dates, eligibility and costs. Primary orientation ex ante: long BOTTOM tercile (quiet), short TOP tercile (loud); opposite orientation computed and reported alongside.
filing_arrival_exposure_form.runnability: needs only census acceptance counts - fully runnable, cannot be NOT_RUN by design.
filing_arrival_exposure_form.kill_rule: if EITHER orientation reproduces the anchor SAME-SIGN at >= 0.5x on the identifying metric, the family is DEAD: the process split was costume over filing arrival.

control_arms.explicit_non_arm: a 'routine-only shadow' book (long/short on routine flow alone) is deliberately NOT an arm (exactly three arms): the routine/opportunistic CONTRAST is carried by the anchor's subset construction and persisted as a diagnostic (routine-share composition per leg), and the two mandated controls above carry the falsification burden per the P3 mandate.

falsification_rule: FROZEN, declared before any PnL: (1) SHAM: sham-insider placebo reproduces the anchor's identifying metric (overall risk-matched SPY-excess alpha) same-sign >= 0.5x => family DEAD. (2) ARRIVAL: filing-arrival exposure-form book reproduces the anchor same-sign >= 0.5x in either pre-declared orientation => family DEAD (arrival, not informedness). (3) SELF-SUBSUMPTION: pooled anchor-vs-sham Spearman rho >= 0.98 kills the proposal PRE-SCORE at D2 (the V12 measured 0.9923 lesson). (4) NEIGHBOUR opposite sign => withdraw the process reading (support failure). (5) P2 FUNDING: any fold where the opportunistic subset fails the per-fold funding floor => BLOCKED_DATA_OR_SELECTION at P2, the cheap death; the neighbour cannot substitute for the anchor's funding. (6) No rescue, no threshold change, no universe change, no cost change, no gate change, no classification-rule change after PnL is visible - any such change is forbidden rescue; REJECT and BLOCKED are successful outcomes.

stage_a_gates.basis: frozen gates carried verbatim through the P3 freeze carried_payload (stocks_free_v10_run/baseline_invariants@1 via p3_v13_invariants_freeze.json); no relaxation anywhere; margin-to-fail per gate per arm (P-2).

gates.threshold: ETF positive share <= 0.50 (expected 0.00 by no-ETF-leg construction)
risk-matched SPY-excess alpha > 0 overall AND positive in >= 1/3 of folds; sector-EW relative reported alongside
anchor expectancy > 0 under the cost_mult 2.0 stress rerun on booked PnL
drop-one symbol (after-drop expectancy > 0), drop-one fold (min leave-one-fold-out expectancy > 0) pass
both control books |alpha| < 0.5x anchor |alpha| same-sign; else family DEAD per falsification_rule
distance-to-threshold reported for every gate (P-2); knife-edge survivor (< 0.05 PF margin, < 25% MDD headroom) reported thin regardless of pass count

expected_failure_mode: Sector-beta drowning is the most repeated measured killer in this program and the leading death candidate here too: opportunistic insider flow can carry sector/style tilt, and if the spread is sector context the SPY-excess and sector-EW gates kill it and pooled |rho| vs the momentum and sector-exposure veto entries fails at D2. Second: the sham reproduces the anchor - if permuting direction within date-sector cells preserves the spread, the process label is decoration over window mass. Third: the arrival control reproduces the anchor - filing counts at these names proxy attention/coverage and the split adds nothing. Fourth, specific to this family: the CMP classification may not transfer to this cohort's quarterly windows - the 24-month history seeding weakens fold 1, and if netdir_opp is statistically indistinguishable from the sibling's all-row direction share, the anchor dies either at D2 (pooled rho vs P1 near 1 fails wave distinctness) or in the scored cell (expectancy <= 0). Fifth: cost death at band C on small-cap filers; the stress x2 tier is expected to be the binding margin. Each death is a successful test; none is a tuning opportunity.
dead_leg_handling: identical to sibling SFV13-A4-P1: DEAD_EVIDENCED legs priced on death-inclusive series, exit-at-last-close, delisting returns carried by the price series itself - no survivorship re-substitution, no synthetic penalty or continuation; zero-window events (defined exposure, no fillable bar) counted and excluded-with-reason; dead entities stop filing at death so in-window rows thin naturally toward death, and the net-opportunistic-sell side contains pre-death mass whose short-side carry includes REALIZED delisting returns; exit costs via resolve_exit_band_bps (C-rate ceiling when UNTRADABLE/missing), L-I3 fail-closed; per-entity legs persisted with the dead/alive split; force-flat at every fold boundary.

expected_fold_population.census_basis_cited_as_given: p0a_form4_census_deadside.json (measured this cycle): 1769 dead cached entities; 1648 with any Form-4; 1562 with bookable pairs; 17072 dead bookable pairs; per-fold dead pairs 8136 / 6114 / 2822; acceptance_datetime population 100%; canary CANARY_PASS_CHANNEL_RETAINS_DEAD; 9 TRUNCATION_SLICE entities flagged.
expected_fold_population.alive_side_status: the 410 ALIVE_EVIDENCED census (p0a_combined) was pending the alive-fetch lock waiter at P3 freeze; verification completes at P2 coverage-first before any scored cell.
expected_fold_population.per_fold_expectation: 10 decision dates per fold; dead-side pairs average ~814 / 611 / 282 per decision date in folds 1/2/3 before eligibility floors. The ANCHOR's opportunistic subset is expected materially below the all-row population - the routine share of insider flow is literature-expected to be roughly half (CMP 2012), and fold 1 is further thinned by the declared 24-month identity-history seeding; the exact retention is an ex-ante UNKNOWN measured at P2 - no retention number is claimed here. The NEIGHBOUR (large buckets, no history seeding) funds from fold 1.
expected_fold_population.predeclared_kill: if at P2 coverage-first ANY fold funds fewer than 250 bookable pairs after the anchor's own exposure floor (the frozen per-fold census floor), or fewer than 2 sectors with >= 6 eligible ranked names persist across a fold, the ANCHOR - and with it the family - dies at P2 as BLOCKED_DATA_OR_SELECTION. Floors and the classification rule are frozen here and never relaxed.

d2_predeclarations.exposure_definition_for_rho: at each frozen decision date t, for each eligible entity e: exposure = netdir_opp(e,t) as specified in features_and_lags, from acceptance-stamped Form-4 rows only; no price input. D2 computes pooled Spearman rho (midrank ties, pooled over the 30 frozen decision dates) between this exposure rank vector and EACH of the FOURTEEN veto entries' exposures; gate |rho| <= 0.20 per entry, measured pre-selection, fail-closed.
d2_predeclarations.anchor_vs_sham_identifiability: pooled |rho| anchor-vs-sham <= 0.30 gate (declared expected band 0.00-0.15; the sham preserves the routine/opportunistic composition, so its exposure differs from the anchor only through the direction relabelling); per-date rho <= 0.30 on >= 90% of dates; self-subsumption: pooled rho >= 0.98 kills pre-score (V12 measured 0.9923 lesson).
d2_predeclarations.anchor_vs_arrival: pooled rho anchor-vs-arrival-count measured and reported; the OPERATIVE gate is the arrival BOOK's falsification rule (same-sign >= 0.5x kills).
d2_predeclarations.sibling_distinctness_informational: pooled rho between this anchor's exposure (opportunistic subset) and the sibling SFV13-A4-P1 exposure (all-row netdir) is positive by set inclusion - the sibling's stream CONTAINS this anchor's stream - but expected materially below 1.0 because the routine calendar mass, the majority of insider flow, is REMOVED here; measured at D2 for wave bookkeeping: if measured near 1.0, the two proposals are the same exposure and wave diversity kills the duplicate at selection (bookkeeping, predeclared, informational for this proposal).

diagnostic_commitments: per the P3-frozen diagnostic_output_contract (P-11): per-period (decision-date) returns series per arm per fold (DSR computable at terminal, N = 39 + V13 cells); per-entity legs with the dead/alive split AND the routine/opportunistic composition per leg; margin-to-fail per gate per arm (P-2); fill-level cost lines proving linear-in-fills and charge-exactly-once; BOTH control-book series persisted alongside the anchor under IDENTICAL semantics; the neighbour series under the same contract; the defect table (fail-closed rows, excluded-with-reason events, truncation flags) and per-bucket size/process diagnostics. Artifacts relative-path-only; persistability validated before A7 launch; twin smoke-rerun re-emits the series.
novelty_argument: The conditioning observable is an insider's DEVIATION FROM THEIR OWN TRADING CALENDAR - a process property of the transaction stream computed from acceptance timestamps alone. No veto entry reads Form-4 flow in any form: momentum and the vol family condition on returns; the V8/V9 families condition on fundamentals-panel levels and flows; the V10-V12 timing/revision/amendment families condition on the amendment process of fundamentals documents; the V12 death-event contagion form is a death-calendar book. The nearest shadow of this anchor is the sibling SFV13-A4-P1 all-row direction book - and the relationship is handled structurally, not rhetorically: this anchor's stream EXCLUDES the routine calendar mass that dominates P1's exposure, the exclusion rule is frozen before any PnL, and the pooled rho between the two exposures is predeclared for D2 measurement so a duplicate pair dies at selection bookkeeping rather than surviving as one idea wearing two IDs. Against the arrival shadow the design is similarly structural: the plain arrival book is a mandatory control that must not reproduce the anchor. The classification uses only evidenced acceptance stamps - no self-reported transactionDate, no asserted lag - keeping the family inside the house PIT standard. Novelty is MEASURED at D2 (pooled |rho| <= 0.20 vs all fourteen, exposure formula predeclared); this prose claims design intent only.
outcome_blind_note: written from the frozen packet only (plan sections 1-2, p3 freeze, p0 contract, p0a/p0b censuses); no scored outcome exists anywhere and none was sought.
